review: Read exact three-path source/test diff before implementer conclusions. Generated source is imported under candidate refs and durable invocation metadata before validation can fail and draft cleanup can run. Candidate metadata is distinct from prepared/accepted operations and does not make normal recovery eligible.

Explicit recoverCandidate binds repository/thread/invocation, required revision, current accepted base, retained ref, tree and parent. It runs the existing trusted validator once, requires test/build success and exact revision plus source/archive digests, rejects source mutation, rechecks lease/base, then uses the existing CAS acceptance and mandatory publication path.

Already accepted continuation verifies original accepted record and publication without re-executing generated source. Prepared/uncertain acceptance retains existing reconciliation behavior; no provider call is introduced. Failed validator propagates and releases the draft/queue without automatically retrying.

Focused checks use actual Git repositories with controlled validator/publication fixtures. They verify source survives draft cleanup, restart continuation and exact hosted reply/finish without extra provider calls, rejected identity/ref/base/source/tests, storage/revision budgets, same-thread ownership, lease loss and prior accepted recovery boundaries.

Candidate records count toward the existing revision budget, and existing storage size checks cover retained repository plus temporary checkout. No new cache/retry framework or test assertions removed.
limitations: Scoped component approval; validation/publication doubles are labelled fixtures. No live Docker, model, chain, service or remote GitHub operations were performed.
This does not revive any terminal accounted-without-reply request. Current Garden terminal billing and fresh end-to-end accepted publication remain separate acceptance evidence.
